name: claude-security-audit
description: Static-analysis security audit for Claude Code project configurations and enabled plugins. 28 rules across 7 aspects (secrets, permissions incl. PERM-005 schema-typo, hooks, MCP, CLAUDE.md, prompt-injection, marketplace). Two-flag auto-fix + 5-layer defense-in-depth (T2-H). Durable finding_uid survives whitespace edits (T2-I). Self-tamper detection (T1-F). Zero ambient surface (T1-C — SessionStart reminder is opt-in). Inspired by AgentShield in Everything Claude Code (Mustafa, 2026; MIT).
